## Shape Counts

```{r Count of Manhattan-ish Shapes}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show code"

manhattan_territory_counts <- data.frame(
  type = c("ZIP Code Tabulation Areas", "Census Tracts", "Census Block Groups", "Census Blocks", "Grid: 0.01 x 0.01", "Grid: 100 m x 100 m"),
  count = c(
    nrow(zcta_manhattan),
    nrow(new_york_county_tracts),
    nrow(new_york_county_bg),
    nrow(new_york_county_blocks),
    nrow(manhattan_custom_01_grid),
    nrow(manhattan_custom_grid)))

datatable(manhattan_territory_counts, rownames = FALSE) %>%
  formatRound('count', digits = 0, mark = ",")
```
